title: [ci] Add the Claude CI flake-fix caller
body:
Adds the weekly Claude flake-fix agent — triages recent CircleCI failures on `master` and, unless report-only, opens a draft PR proposing a fix. Calls mui-public's reusable `claude-flake-fix.yml` (pinned `c6471a4f`, tracks `master`); mirrors the mui-x and base-ui rollout.

Runs Monday 07:00 UTC and on manual dispatch (`report-only`, `model` inputs; defaults to opus). No secrets: the four `ANTHROPIC_*` vars are already set and CircleCI is read unauthenticated. Before merge, allow GitHub Actions to create pull requests (Settings → Actions → General).
